answer.completion_criteria: At the same commit, observe deploy pass with sanitized logs and smoke-tests actually run; record any separately authorized credential response without copying secret values.

Step: verify signature => skipped

answer.observed_failure: The artifact fetch step exited 1 on HTTP 403; the subsequent signature verification did not execute.
answer.cause_hypothesis_and_uncertainty: Possibly an expired signed URL, invalid authorization or incorrect object policy; the 403 does not prove compromise. The log includes a signature-like URL parameter requiring redaction.
answer.next_verification: Have an authorized operator inspect expiry, intended object and access policy without opening, forwarding or copying the signed URL; compare a new securely provisioned reference and repeat the fetch, then run integrity verification.
answer.completion_criteria: A same-commit rerun must fetch the expected object and execute verified signature checking without exposing signed URL parameters.
